title: The Reward at the End of a 1,300-Year-Old Street | Guangzhou Heritage Day P4 | China Travel Expert
description:
Four heritage stops, all walkable in a day — and this is the reward at the finish line: yum cha on Guangzhou's oldest street.

Shangxiajiu in Guangzhou's Liwan (Xiguan) district is a 1,218-metre pedestrian street whose commercial history reaches back over 1,300 years. You walk it under qilou — covered arcade buildings whose ground-floor colonnades shelter you from both rain and sun. The finish line of this route is Cantonese morning tea: 一盅两件 (one pot of tea, two dim sum), served in dim sum houses over a century old. It's the reward stop that closes our 4-part Guangzhou Heritage Day walking route.

🧭 Expert Tip: Arrive before 10am for the freshest har gow, and go at your own pace — the point of yum cha is to linger, not to rush.

一条走了1300年的老街，终点藏着一顿广式早茶。
